title: Inventory Status Checker

qQuery.title: Inventory Status
qQuery.prompt: how the top 5 products with sufficient inventory and very low inventory for this month from product_master.csv

title: Top Products Affected by Tariff Increase
description: Identifies the top 5 products affected by tariff increase based on primary supplier country
initialPrompt: read the product_master.csv and supplier_master.csv to identify top 5 products affected by tariff increase based on the primary supplier country

qQuery.title: Top Products Affected By Tarrif
qQuery.prompt: Using the product_master.csv file @and supplier_master.csv file source files identify the top 5 products that will be most affected by a tariff increase based on the primary supplier country for each product.

title: Alternative Supplier Recommendation
description: Find alternative suppliers to reduce tariff impact on a given product

qQuery.title: Alternative Supplier Recommendations
qQuery.prompt: Using the product name @Product Name and the provided product_master.csv file and supplier_master.csv file, find alternative sources that can reduce tariff impact on the given product. Explain the reasons behind the recommendations.
